# Afaq Ul Islam

> Agentic AI engineer and full-stack developer, and Co-Founder & COO at Neofyx — building multi-agent AI systems, automation workflows and web applications from Karachi, Pakistan.

Afaq Ul Islam is an Agentic AI engineer and full-stack developer who designs, builds and ships products from spec to deployment. He is Co-Founder and Chief Operating Officer at Neofyx, an AI automation and SaaS startup, where he leads agentic AI products, engineering, operations and client delivery. His work spans multi-agent systems and LLM integration (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Groq), full-stack web development (Next.js, React, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python), databases (PostgreSQL, Firebase) and AI workflow automation with n8n.

## Key facts
- Role: Agentic AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer; Co-Founder & COO at Neofyx
- Location: Karachi, Pakistan
- Education: BS Computational Mathematics, University of Karachi (in progress); Certificate in Full-Stack Development & AI, Governor Sindh Initiative for GenAI, Web3 and Metaverse (GIAIC)
- Recognition: Silver Tier, Google AI Seekho 2026 (Kisaan Dost AI); Top 10%, GIAIC Batch 1
- Open source: 70+ public repositories on GitHub

## Core skills
- Programming: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: FastAPI, REST APIs
- Databases: PostgreSQL, Firebase
- AI & Agentic AI: AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, LLM Integration, Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Groq
- Automation: n8n, AI Workflow Automation

## Selected projects
- StartupLaunch AI: Multi-agent system that runs market research, competitor analysis and risk assessment, then delivers a Go / No-Go / Pivot verdict (Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI).
- TaskSnap AI: Turns screenshots of messy messages into prioritized, deadline-aware task lists using Tesseract.js OCR and Groq AI (Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4).
- Kisaan Dost AI: AI crop disease detection for Pakistani farmers with Gemini Vision, Roman Urdu diagnosis and voice reports.
- Handbook: Governed Knowledge System of Record turning scattered policies into cited, permission-aware answers with RAG, pgvector and an MCP server.
- ShiftSathi: AI-grounded frontline operations assistant for factories and workshops, built with Next.js and TypeScript.
